about: Hand-maintained list of market-moving dates for NQ. Only dates that follow a fixed rule or that were published are dated. verify: true means check the source before relying on it (agencies move releases and exchanges change holiday hours). A release whose date is not known is in 'undated', never guessed. All times are New York (ET) clock times.
